role: Single construction point for HKQuantitySample/HKCategorySample that returns nil instead of letting HealthKit raise an uncatchable ObjC exception for non-finite values or backwards intervals.

units.does: True when both dates have finite reference intervals and end >= start.
Returns an HKQuantitySample for value/unit over start...end, or nil when value is not finite or the interval is invalid.

branches.cond: value not finite or interval invalid
branches.effect: returns nil; otherwise constructs the sample

units.does: Returns an HKCategorySample over start...end, or nil for an invalid interval.

branches.effect: returns nil; otherwise constructs the sample
